reason: The text from 1 Kings 19 actually demonstrates the opposite. Multiple characters express their views freely and openly: Ahab reports information to Jezebel (וַיַּגֵּד), Elijah directly articulates his grievances to God ('I have been very zealous for the LORD God of hosts...'), and God engages him in dialogue asking 'What are you doing here, Elijah?' (מַה־לְּךָ פֹה). Elijah is not discouraged from expressing his concerns; rather, he vocalizes them clearly to the divine. The narrative shows active, uninhibited expression of views across multiple characters.
